entities.summary: Cynthia Gellibert, is an Ecuadorian politician who has been the Secretary General of Public Administration since 2024. She was the acting Vice President of Ecuador from 30 March 2025 until 24 May 2025, replacing the elected-Vice President Veronica Abad.
